eval_only.mechanism: the predicate lives in src/eval/, is imported only by this builder, and the training scene sampler src/envs/scene_init.py does not reference it; training therefore still experiences the region 03_train 1.2 requires

viability_screen.omega_reject_source: data/runs/v2.9.3/doom_certificate/measured_rate.json -> max_realised_dtheta_dt, over 240 episodes / 32852 states of data/runs/v2.9.3/failure_atlas/raw
viability_screen.omega_sound_source: sqrt2 * (omega_max + alpha_max * dt), computed from the constants of doom_certificate.md section 1; not typed
viability_screen.predicate_source: the certificate of data/runs/v2.9.3/doom_certificate/make_doom_certificate.py, reused not reimplemented; floor leg called directly, ceiling and horizontal legs proved bit-identical to doom_flags.npz on all 2000 registered scenes before any draw

rejection.semantics: 03_train 1.1 -- a rejected attempt consumes its draws and the whole scene is redrawn; the screen never relaxes

viability_screen.sufficient_not_necessary: flagged means no admissible input could have saved the scene; unflagged does NOT mean survivable
